mapper.select: SELECT dlh.dtDttmH, ROUND(SUM( CASE WHEN m.dValidInstrInteger IS NULL OR m.dValidInstrInteger = 0 OR dlh.dFapDiff IS NULL OR dlh.dFapDiff = 0 THEN 0 ELSE dlh.dFapDiff / m.dValidInstrInteger END ), 0) AS usage FROM data_lp2_hour22 dlh LEFT JOIN meter_tmp2 m ON dlh.mid = m.mid WHERE dlh.dtDttm = #{today} GROUP BY dlh.dtDttmH ORDER BY dlh.dtDttmH ASC
